metrics.label: 复购率
metrics.description: 统计周期内下单 2 次及以上的用户数 ÷ 统计周期内下单用户数。按维度拆分时在每个分组内分别计算。

answer.text: 按区域看，复购率同比变化最大的是西南：2025-09 为 14.4%，2026-09 为 22.5%，上升 8.1 个百分点。

queries.title: 复购率
queries.sql:
SELECT
  t.period AS period,
  t.region AS region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers,
  COUNT(*) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.orders_in_period >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    4
  ) AS repurchase_rate
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id AS customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      THEN '2026-09'
      ELSE '2025-09'
    END AS period,
    r.region_name AS region,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_in_period
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN regions AS r
    ON o.region_id = r.region_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
    AND (
      o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      OR o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2025-09-30'
    )
  GROUP BY
    o.customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
      THEN '2026-09'
      ELSE '2025-09'
    END,
    r.region_name
) AS t
GROUP BY
  t.period,
  t.region
ORDER BY
  period,
  region
LIMIT 1000
